prompt: On an unseen reviewer cluster, diagnose an Accepted Gateway route returning 503 where the Service resolves, one EndpointSlice has a wrong named port, and default-deny blocks one source namespace. Recover least privilege and prove cleanup.
deliverables: Exact versions, contexts, identities, nodes and five-tuples.
DNS, Gateway attachment and data-plane evidence kept separate.
Service/EndpointSlice targetRef UID, readiness and named-port analysis.
Source-egress and destination-ingress policy decision for allowed and denied namespaces.
Direct endpoint, ClusterIP and external Host/path comparison.
Positive and negative verification including served revision.
Exact namespace, route, policy, address, credential and cluster cleanup.
evidenceRequirements: Reviewer supplies unseen identities and failure combination.
Learner is namespace-scoped; reviewer owns node/capture/cluster lifecycle.
No public load balancer, external registry, host network, privileged capture or node-rule mutation.
Evidence tied to UID, version, node, five-tuple and UTC time.
One failed hypothesis preserved and corrected.
Reviewer observes cleanup and delayed changed topology.
